observations.why: Imperative directive with no hedging; the speaker instructs erasure as a settled operational action, not a proposal — but lacks ratification language or performed declarative that would lift it to principle.

Unhedged imperative specifying a concrete operational action with universal scope ('all knowledge'); the speaker expects compliance, performing a settled instruction rather than arguing for a position.
Flat unhedged declarative asserted as fact, but it is a factual claim offered for acceptance — no ratification language or performed settling lifts it to decision.
